data.title: Sponsorship Opportunities
data.subtitle: Partner with DSMLC and connect with the next generation of data science and machine learning professionals.

data.title: Sponsorship Benefits
descriptions: Sponsoring DSMLC presents a unique opportunity to engage with the next generation of data science and machine learning professionals. By partnering with us, sponsors will receive several benefits that enhance brand visibility, provide direct access to talent, and offer meaningful engagement with the data science community.

bullets.title: Brand Visibility
bullets.text: Your company’s logo will be featured on event promotional materials, including posters, flyers, and social media, positioning your brand in front of a targeted group of students pursuing careers in data science and machine learning.

bullets.title: Direct Access to Top Talent
bullets.text: DSMLC members are some of the brightest and most driven students at the University of Calgary. As a sponsor, you will have opportunities to connect directly with students through our events, competitions, and workshops, providing access to potential interns and future employees.

bullets.title: Industry Engagement
bullets.text: By supporting DSMLC, your company demonstrates a commitment to advancing education and innovation in data science and machine learning. Your sponsorship directly contributes to developing future professionals equipped to tackle real-world challenges.

bullets.title: Networking Opportunities
bullets.text: Sponsors are invited to attend DSMLC events, where they can engage with students and professionals, fostering valuable connections within the academic and data science communities.

bullets.title: Exclusive Benefits
bullets.text: Higher-tier sponsorships include exclusive opportunities, such as speaking engagements, event MC roles, and recognition in opening and closing ceremonies, allowing your company to stand out as a leader in supporting student education and professional growth.

data.text: We offer three levels of sponsorship to suit a range of company needs and objectives. Each level provides unique benefits that increase with the level of investment.

points.text: Large company logo on all event promotional materials, acknowledgment during opening and closing ceremonies, two complimentary tickets to events, recognition on our social media pages, opportunity to MC the event, booth at the event, exclusive partnership for the next event.

Medium company logo on event posters and flyers, acknowledgment during opening and closing ceremonies, one complimentary ticket to events, recognition on our social media pages, opportunity to MC the event, speaking opportunity at the next event.
Small company logo on event posters and flyers, acknowledgment during opening and closing ceremonies, recognition on our social media pages.

data.title: DSMLC Final Competition Sponsorship
data.subtitle: Support our annual competition and connect with the next generation of data science and machine learning talent.

data.text: The DSMLC Final Competition offers three sponsorship levels—Gold, Silver, and Bronze. Each level provides unique benefits and engagement opportunities to maximize brand visibility and interaction with students and professionals.

points.text: Exceptional brand visibility and exclusive engagement opportunities, ideal for businesses seeking maximum exposure and meaningful connections with the student and professional community.
Prominent recognition through acknowledgments and brand placement, perfect for businesses looking to solidify their influence within the data science community.
A great entry-level opportunity for businesses aiming for early-stage engagement and brand recognition among aspiring data science professionals.
